admission.justification: A model supplied without an agent is the one shape that would otherwise invent a provider; binding it to the caller's honest harness is what keeps the override honest.

applicability: A Bootstrap start that supplies a model without naming an agent.
conditions: The provider comes from an honest caller-harness signal, and validation runs through the existing selection owner.
Other roles keep refusing a model that arrives without its agent.
When the caller's harness cannot be hosted and no agent is named, the start is refused and lists the harnesses the host can run instead of selecting the first one.
exclusions: Guessing a provider when the harness signal is absent.
statement: A Bootstrap model-only override binds the honest caller provider and validates through the existing selection owner without weakening other-role binding.
